$comment: Shared soundscape settings, read by the web walk-through (frontend/src/lib/soundscape.ts) and the iPhone app (ios-scanner/TouchSpaceScanner/SoundscapeSettings.swift). Distances are meters, angles are degrees (0 = straight ahead, positive = to the right), times are seconds, gains are linear (1 = unchanged). See docs/soundscape.md.
$zones_comment: Ahead is narrow on purpose: about body width at 2 meters, so it means "in my path", not "somewhere in front".

lidar_camera_zones.$comment: The iPhone camera only sees about 60 degrees ahead, so on the phone each zone is a slice of the depth image (fractions of its width) instead of an angle range.

muffle.$comment: Each ear has its own noise. As the nearest surface on that side gets closer than open_at_m, its high frequencies are cut and it gets a little quieter. At muffled_at_m and closer it is fully muffled.

ahead_pulse.$comment: Something straight ahead adds soft ticks in both ears, faster as it gets closer. Nothing ahead within start_at_m means no ticks.

cues.$comment: Distinct sounds so silence never has to mean anything. 'no_data' repeats while there is no information (outside the map, or the phone lost tracking), so it can't be mistaken for open space.
